content.content:
=== tasks.GET.yml ===
# GET /api/projects/{projectId}/tasks -> list every task on one project (ProjectTasksGet.service).
service:
  class: net.officefloor.hq.app.ProjectTasksGet
=== toggle POST.yml ===
# POST /api/tasks/{id}/toggle -> tick a task off or back on, recording an audit entry (TaskToggle.service).
service:
  class: net.officefloor.hq.app.TaskToggle
=== lineitems.POST.yml ===
# POST /api/invoices/{id}/lineitems -> add a line to an invoice (InvoiceLineItemsPost.service).
service:
  class: net.officefloor.hq.app.InvoiceLineItemsPost
=== lineitem remove POST.yml ===
# POST /api/invoices/{id}/lineitems/{lineItemId}/remove -> remove a line from an invoice (InvoiceLineItemRemove.service).
service:
  class: net.officefloor.hq.app.InvoiceLineItemRemove
=== V10 ===
-- Tasks: a project's checklist. Each task has a title, a done flag, and belongs to a project.
-- GENERATED BY DEFAULT (not ALWAYS) so the /__test__ seed path can insert explicit fixture ids.
CREATE TABLE tasks (
    id         BIGINT       GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    title      VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    done       BOOLEAN      NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    project_id BIGINT       NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id)
);
=== V3 ===
-- Projects: the second domain table. A project has a name and belongs to a client (client_id FK).
-- GENERATED BY DEFAULT (not ALWAYS) so the /__test__ seed path can insert explicit fixture ids.
CREATE TABLE projects (
    id        BIGINT       GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    name      VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    client_id BIGINT       NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id)
);
=== V11 ===
-- Invoice line items: the things an invoice is charging for. Each line has a description, a
-- quantity and a unit price, and belongs to an invoice (invoice_id FK). An invoice's amount is the
-- sum of each line's qty * unit_price. GENERATED BY DEFAULT (not ALWAYS) so the /__test__ seed path
-- can insert explicit fixture ids.
CREATE TABLE invoice_line_items (
    id          BIGINT        GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    invoice_id  BIGINT        NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices(id),
    description VARCHAR(255)  NOT NULL,
    qty         INTEGER       NOT NULL,
    unit_price  DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL
);

-- Labels for projects: a reusable pool of tags, and a join table linking a project to each tag it
-- carries so a project can be grouped by any number of labels (many-to-many). GENERATED BY DEFAULT
-- (not ALWAYS) so the /__test__ seed path can insert explicit fixture ids.
CREATE TABLE tags (
    id   BIGINT       GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL
);

-- One row per (project, tag) pairing. The pair is the primary key, so a tag cannot be added to the
-- same project twice.
CREATE TABLE project_tags (
    project_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
    tag_id     BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags(id),

);

## Summary

I implemented **project labels (tags)** as a full-stack, additive change following the app's conventions.

**Database** (`src/main/resources/db/migration/V13__project_tags.sql`)
- New `tags` pool table and a `project_tags` many-to-many join table (`(project_id, tag_id)` as the primary key, so a label can't be added twice).

**Server** (OfficeFloor REST on Spring Boot)
- Entities/repos: `Tag`, `ProjectTag` (+ `ProjectTagId` composite key), `TagRepository`, `ProjectTagRepository`.
- Logic classes + YAML wirings for four `/api/*` endpoints:
  - `GET /api/tags` — the shared label pool (feeds the picker)
  - `GET /api/projects/{projectId}/tags` — a project's chips
  - `POST /api/projects/{projectId}/tags` — attach a label (404 unknown project/tag, 400 missing tagId)
  - `POST /api/projects/{projectId}/tags/{tagId}/remove` — detach a label
- Extended `/__test__` seed support: added `tags` + `project_tags` to the truncate list (child-before-parent) and seed handlers keyed by `tags` / `projectTags`, inserting with the fixture's explicit ids via `JdbcTemplate`.

**Front-end** (new files only — nothing existing edited)
- `features/tags/queries.ts` — `useQuery` keys `['tags']` and `['projects', id, 'tags']`, plus add/remove mutation fns.
- `features/tags/ProjectTags.tsx` — chips (`project-tag-{id}`), per-chip remove (`project-tag-remove-{id}`), the picker `select` (`project-tag-add`) showing not-yet-assigned labels, and `project-tag-add-submit`. Reads its own data; mutations `invalidateQueries` the shared key; only the uncommitted picker choice uses `useState`.
- `features/tags/tags.slot.tsx` — fills the existing `ProjectDetail` slot (rule 3), so the project detail page renders it without being touched.

Verification: `bin/e2e` → **1 passed**; frontend `npm run typecheck` clean.
